# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_cli_reference.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

This page is the `--help` output of every `tau2` command, generated from the
CLI. Regenerate it after changing any option:

```bash
UV_FROZEN=1 uv run python scripts/generate_cli_reference.py
```

For a walkthrough, see [Getting started](getting-started.md) and
[Running simulations](running_simulations.md). Running `tau2` with no command
(or `tau2 intro`) prints a short overview in the terminal. The CLI covers the
airline domain in text (turn-based) mode only.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`tau2 run`](#tau2-run) | Run agents on the airline tasks |
| [`tau2 view`](#tau2-view) | View simulation results |
| [`tau2 domain`](#tau2-domain) | Show domain documentation |
| [`tau2 intro`](#tau2-intro) | Show an overview of the framework and available commands |
| [`tau2 check-data`](#tau2-check-data) | Check if data directory is properly configured |
| [`tau2 evaluate-trajs`](#tau2-evaluate-trajs) | Evaluate trajectories and update rewards |
| [`tau2 review`](#tau2-review) | Run LLM-based conversation review on simulation results |
| [`tau2 convert-results`](#tau2-convert-results) | Convert simulation results between storage formats |

## `tau2`

```text
usage: tau2 [-h]
            {run,view,domain,intro,check-data,evaluate-trajs,review,convert-results}
            ...

Tau2 command line interface

positional arguments:
  {run,view,domain,intro,check-data,evaluate-trajs,review,convert-results}
                        Available commands
    run                 Run agents on the airline tasks
    view                View simulation results
    domain              Show domain documentation
    intro               Show an overview of the framework and available commands
    check-data          Check if data directory is properly configured
    evaluate-trajs      Evaluate trajectories and update rewards
    review              Run LLM-based conversation review on simulation results
    convert-results     Convert simulation results between storage formats

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

## `tau2 run`

```text
usage: tau2 run [-h] [--domain {airline}] [--num-trials NUM_TRIALS]
                [--agent {llm_agent,gated_cancel_agent,llm_agent_gt}]
                [--agent-llm AGENT_LLM] [--agent-llm-args AGENT_LLM_ARGS]
                [--user {user_simulator}] [--user-llm USER_LLM]
                [--user-llm-args USER_LLM_ARGS] [--task-set-name {airline}]
                [--task-split-name TASK_SPLIT_NAME]
                [--task-ids TASK_IDS [TASK_IDS ...]] [--num-tasks NUM_TASKS]
                [--max-steps MAX_STEPS] [--max-errors MAX_ERRORS] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                [--save-to SAVE_TO] [--max-concurrency MAX_CONCURRENCY] [--seed SEED]
                [--log-level LOG_LEVEL] [--verbose-logs] [--llm-log-mode {all,latest}]
                [--max-retries MAX_RETRIES] [--retry-delay RETRY_DELAY]
                [--enforce-communication-protocol]
                [--communicate-scorer {semantic,substring}] [--communicate-judge JSON]
                [--reason-scoring {gate,report,off}] [--reason-judge JSON]
                [--auto-resume] [--auto-review] [--review-mode {full,user}]
                [--review-model REVIEW_MODEL] [--dry-run]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --domain {airline}, -d {airline}
                        The domain to run the simulation on. Default is airline.
  --num-trials NUM_TRIALS
                        The number of times each task is run. Default is 1.
  --agent {llm_agent,gated_cancel_agent,llm_agent_gt}
                        The agent implementation to use. Default is llm_agent.
  --agent-llm AGENT_LLM
                        The OpenRouter model ID of the agent's LLM. Default is
                        openai/gpt-6.1-sol.
  --agent-llm-args AGENT_LLM_ARGS
                        The arguments to pass to the LLM for the agent, as JSON.
                        Default is '{"reasoning_effort": "medium"}'.
  --user {user_simulator}
                        The user implementation to use. Default is user_simulator.
  --user-llm USER_LLM   The OpenRouter model ID of the user simulator's LLM. Default
                        is openai/gpt-6.1-sol. The released tau-bench 2.0 text
                        benchmark uses openai/gpt-5.5.
  --user-llm-args USER_LLM_ARGS
                        The arguments to pass to the LLM for the user, as JSON.
                        Default is '{"reasoning_effort": "low"}'. The released text
                        benchmark uses '{"reasoning_effort": "low"}'.
  --task-set-name {airline}
                        The task set to run the simulation on. If not provided, will
                        load default task set for the domain.
  --task-split-name TASK_SPLIT_NAME
                        The task split to run the simulation on (base, train, test or
                        scored). Default is 'base'.
  --task-ids TASK_IDS [TASK_IDS ...]
                        Run only these task IDs.
  --num-tasks NUM_TASKS
                        Run only the first N selected tasks.
  --max-steps MAX_STEPS
                        The maximum number of steps to run the simulation. Default is
                        200.
  --max-errors MAX_ERRORS
                        The maximum number of tool errors allowed in a simulation
                        before it is stopped. Default is 10.
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Maximum wallclock time in seconds for each simulation. No
                        timeout by default.
  --save-to SAVE_TO, --output SAVE_TO
                        The path to save the simulation results. Will be saved to
                        data/simulations/<save_to>/results.json. If not provided, will
                        save to <timestamp>_<domain>_<agent>_<agent-llm>_<user>_<user-
                        llm>. If the file already exists, it will try to resume the
                        run.
  --max-concurrency MAX_CONCURRENCY
                        The maximum number of concurrent simulations to run. Default
                        is 3.
  --seed SEED           The seed to use for the simulation. Default is 300.
  --log-level LOG_LEVEL
                        The log level to use for the simulation. Default is ERROR.
  --verbose-logs        Enable verbose logging: saves LLM call logs and per-task logs.
                        Files are saved to the save directory (auto-generated if
                        --save-to not specified).
  --llm-log-mode {all,latest}
                        LLM debug logging mode. Only takes effect when --verbose-logs
                        is enabled. 'all' saves every LLM call (can generate many
                        files), 'latest' keeps only the most recent call of each type
                        (saves space). Default is 'latest'.
  --max-retries MAX_RETRIES
                        Maximum number of retries for failed tasks. Default is 3.
  --retry-delay RETRY_DELAY
                        Delay in seconds between retries. Default is 1.0.
  --enforce-communication-protocol
                        Enforce communication protocol rules (e.g., no mixed messages
                        with text and tool calls). Default is False.
  --communicate-scorer {semantic,substring}
                        Communicate-info scorer: the pinned semantic LLM judge
                        (default) or the original substring matching of tau2-bench
                        1.x.
  --communicate-judge JSON
                        Semantic judge overrides, e.g. {"model": "...", "model_args":
                        {...}}.
  --reason-scoring {gate,report,off}
                        Decision-reason scoring against the golden labels: 'gate'
                        multiplies REASON into the final reward, 'report' records the
                        judge's verdict without changing the reward, 'off' skips it.
                        Default: gate.
  --reason-judge JSON   Reason judge overrides, e.g. {"model": "...", "model_args":
                        {...}}.
  --auto-resume         Automatically resume from existing save file without prompting
                        (for non-interactive runs).
  --auto-review         Automatically run LLM conversation review after each
                        simulation.
  --review-mode {full,user}
                        Review mode when --auto-review is enabled: 'full' (agent+user
                        errors, default) or 'user' (user simulator only).
  --review-model REVIEW_MODEL
                        OpenRouter model ID used for review calls. Default is
                        openai/gpt-6-luna.
  --dry-run             Print the resolved run configuration as JSON without running
                        anything.
```

## `tau2 view`

```text
usage: tau2 view [-h] [--dir DIR] [--file FILE] [--only-show-failed]
                 [--only-show-all-failed]
                 [--max-tool-result-chars MAX_TOOL_RESULT_CHARS] [--full-tool-results]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dir DIR             Directory containing simulation run directories. Defaults to
                        data/simulations.
  --file FILE           Path to a simulation results file or run directory
  --only-show-failed    Only show failed tasks.
  --only-show-all-failed
                        Only show tasks that failed in all trials.
  --max-tool-result-chars MAX_TOOL_RESULT_CHARS
                        Truncate tool results to this many characters. Default: 500.
  --full-tool-results   Show full tool results without truncation.
```

## `tau2 evaluate-trajs`

```text
usage: tau2 evaluate-trajs [-h] [-o OUTPUT_DIR] [--fresh-tasks]
                           [--reason-scoring {gate,report,off}] [--reason-judge JSON]
                           paths [paths ...]

positional arguments:
  paths                 Paths to trajectory files, directories, or glob patterns

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -o OUTPUT_DIR, --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Directory to save updated trajectory files with recomputed
                        rewards. If not provided, only displays metrics.
  --fresh-tasks         Re-grade against the current task definitions from the data
                        directory instead of the ones embedded in each results file.
  --reason-scoring {gate,report,off}
                        Decision-reason scoring against the golden labels: 'gate'
                        multiplies REASON into the final reward, 'report' records the
                        judge's verdict without changing the reward, 'off' skips it.
                        Default: the scorer recorded in each results file.
  --reason-judge JSON   Reason judge overrides, e.g. {"model": "...", "model_args":
                        {...}}.
```

## `tau2 review`

```text
usage: tau2 review [-h] [-m {full,user}] [-o OUTPUT] [--show-details]
                   [-c MAX_CONCURRENCY] [--limit LIMIT]
                   [--task-ids TASK_IDS [TASK_IDS ...]] [--log-llm]
                   [--review-model REVIEW_MODEL]
                   path

positional arguments:
  path                  Path to a results.json file or a directory containing
                        results.json files

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -m {full,user}, --mode {full,user}
                        Review mode: 'full' (agent+user, default) or 'user' (user
                        simulator only)
  -o OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT
                        Output path for the reviewed results (only used for single
                        file)
  --show-details        Show detailed review results for each simulation
  -c MAX_CONCURRENCY, --max-concurrency MAX_CONCURRENCY
                        Maximum number of concurrent reviews (default: 32)
  --limit LIMIT         Limit review to first N simulations
  --task-ids TASK_IDS [TASK_IDS ...]
                        Only review simulations for these task IDs
  --log-llm             Log LLM request/response for each review call
  --review-model REVIEW_MODEL
                        OpenRouter model ID used for review calls. Default is
                        openai/gpt-6-luna.
```

## `tau2 convert-results`

```text
usage: tau2 convert-results [-h] [--to {json,dir}] [--no-backup] path

positional arguments:
  path             Path to results.json or results directory to convert

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --to {json,dir}  Target format: 'json' (monolithic) or 'dir' (directory with
                   individual sim files). If omitted, converts to the opposite of the
                   current format.
  --no-backup      Skip creating a .bak backup of the original file
```
